mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, which in turn drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K signals strong demand in the housing sector, leading to positive economic growth expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1200K does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative economic growth expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% MoM does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200K signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive economic growth expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increase > 200K does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 0.5% MoM signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive economic growth expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increase > 0.5% MoM does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, the combination signals a slowing economy with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: slowing economy with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
